name: Orient International Enterprise, Ltd.
summary: Orient International Enterprise, Ltd. engages in logistics business in China, the United States, Europe, Africa, and Asia and the Pacific Region. The company imports and exports commodities for textile raw materials, textile products, and mechanical and electrical products; and medical devices, such as MRI, linac, CT imaging system, digital angiograph, biochemical analyzer, surgical instruments, and other medical equipment and instruments. It also provides warehousing, air freight, shipping and transportation, and international logistics services.
